name: sim_geometry_hyperbolic_volume_constraint_canonical
description: Mostow Rigidity: closed hyperbolic 3-manifolds determined by volume + fundamental group

pytorch.reason: pytorch not needed; pure symbolic/algebraic computation via cvc5 and sympy

pyg.reason: PyG message passing not needed; constraint geometry handled via SMT solver

z3.reason: z3 not needed; cvc5 handles all SMT constraint proofs in this sim

cvc5.reason: cvc5 SMT solver: load_bearing proof of hyperbolic geometry constraints

sympy.reason: sympy: supportive symbolic algebra for hyperbolic volume and geometrization formulas

clifford.reason: Clifford algebra not needed; 3-manifold topology constraints only

geomstats.reason: geomstats not needed; constraints handled via SMT solver

e3nn.reason: e3nn not needed; no SO(3) equivariance required

rustworkx.reason: rustworkx not needed; no graph structure in this sim

xgi.reason: xgi not needed; pairwise interactions only

toponetx.reason: toponetx not needed; standard algebraic ops sufficient

gudhi.reason: gudhi not needed; no persistent homology in this sim

positive_mostow_rigidity_sat.reason: Mostow rigidity: equal volume + equal π_1 rank → isometric (SAT)

positive_dehn_surgery_limit.reason: Dehn surgery formula: Vol(M_{p/q}) → Vol(M) as p,q → ∞

negative_mostow_rank_mismatch.reason: Mostow rigidity violated: equal volume but different π_1 ranks with non-isometric claim (UNSAT)

negative_volume_negative.reason: Negative volume is impossible in hyperbolic geometry (UNSAT)

negative_hyperbolic_trivial_pi1.reason: Hyperbolic manifolds must have non-trivial π_1 (UNSAT)

boundary_weeks_manifold_minimal.reason: Weeks manifold has minimal volume ≈ 0.9427; all others must be larger

boundary_figure8_cusp_volume.reason: Cusped hyperbolic manifolds (e.g., figure-8 complement) have well-defined finite volume

boundary_large_dehn_parameter.reason: Large p,q parameters make Dehn surgery volume approach original volume
